description: Skill-family probe battery for the Harness VLA beta on native LIBERO (libero_90). Extends the difficulty ladder of benchmark_probe_v2 with five skill families not covered by v1/v2: stacking, knob articulation, fixture+pick-place composition, relational placement without a container, and fine-grained container compartments. Comparisons are valid only within this protocol, paired by (task_suite, task_id, initial_state_index, seed). This file is instrumentation for reproducible evaluation; it is not a mechanism from arXiv:2607.08448v2.
change_policy: Never edit this file in place. To change the battery, create eval_protocol_v4.json and report results separately.

budgets.note: Same budgets as benchmark_probe_v2; beta-only calibration choice so budget exhaustion does not mask other failure modes.

tasks.note: stack the middle black bowl on the back black bowl - stacking skill family, object-on-object placement with spatial disambiguation
turn on the stove - knob articulation, empty-hand fixture manipulation distinct from drawers
turn on the stove and put the frying pan on it - fixture articulation composed with pick-and-place
put the white bowl to the right of the plate - relational placement without a container
pick up the book and place it in the left compartment of the caddy - fine-grained compartment grounding

notes: v_1: extends deployment_seeds to 101-103; tasks/budgets identical to parent protocol.
